description: FREE. Catalog of every stock perp and tokenized stock agents can trade: Hyperliquid trade.xyz, Aster and Lighter perps plus Solana xStocks and Ondo Global Markets tokens. Per market: ticker, venue, symbol / Lighter market_id / Solana mint / Ondo contract, type, live and tradable_now. Use first to see where a ticker trades before get_quote or get_funding.

ticker.description: Comma-separated tickers, e.g. TSLA or TSLA,NVDA. Recommended: without it you get 2,000+ rows.

venue.description: Comma-separated: hyperliquid-xyz, aster, lighter, xstocks-solana, ondo-gm

name: list_markets
